observed_in: Pet and Companion System design analysis

definition: This dimension controls the degree of loyalty that companions exhibit towards the player, influencing their behavior in combat and decision-making. Variations can include how loyalty is gained, lost, and its impact on companion effectiveness and actions.
exclusion_criteria: Companions are always loyal without any conditions
Loyalty has no impact on companion behavior or performance
inclusion_criteria: Companions can betray the player under certain conditions
Loyalty can be increased through specific actions or items
title: Companion Loyalty Dynamics
